cases.rationale: The selected ready Change has clear behavior, cause, owner, edit path, authority, and decisive verification; neither diagnosis nor risk-qualified TDD applies.
The reproducible multi-layer failure remains unexplained, so diagnosis precedes TDD or implementation and guessed production mutation is forbidden.
The persisted public state transition is a concrete changed risk for which a pre-mutation RED materially improves safety.
The request grants report-only authority, so readiness and focus do not authorize product, lifecycle, Git, release, or external mutation.
The manual release reference must load first, then stop before versioned mutation because release identity is unconfirmed and the exact candidate is unclean without owner resolution.
Reopen recovery requires exact archive selection when multiple archives match and explicit lifecycle authority before any reopen mutation.
A status inquiry is an update rather than an interruption; Manage reports current evidence and then continues authorized work while checks and authority remain available.
An explicit pause requires interrupting active workers, confirming they stopped, preserving focus, and performing no further mutation until resume.
